title: Magnetic phase
description:
The magnetic phase assigned to the material by the collinear/noncollinear symmetry analysis.

The vocabulary is taken from the MagneticPhase column of the symmetry-summary tables.
`altermagnet` denotes an altermagnetic phase; `compensated ferrimagnet` denotes a fully compensated ferrimagnetic phase.
A null value means no linked symmetry entry provides a magnetic phase for this material.
